tasks.subject: Task 1: Positional stamp in delta normalizer (library patch 0006, TDD)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Each normalized delta node, its property_evidence, and each relationship carry the batch's authoritative positional self_refs/chunk_indexes/page_numbers, with LLM citations preserved separately as cited_refs.

**Files:** Create docker/docling-graph/patches/0006-positional-node-rel-provenance.patch; Create docker/docling-graph/tests/test_positional_provenance_stamp.py; Modify scripts/run_tests.sh.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Node+rel provenance carry positional self_refs/chunk_indexes/page_numbers + cited_refs; evidence_ids = explicit valid only (not batch pool).
- Uncited node keeps positional batch lineage, cited_refs=[].
- Test applies patch stack 0001-0006 to temp repo, 2-chunk batch, cited vs positional split; fails pre-patch passes post.
- All 6 patches --fuzz=0 --dry-run clean.

**Verify:** python3 -m pytest docker/docling-graph/tests/test_positional_provenance_stamp.py -v

tasks.subject: Task 4: Worker resolution — fail to batch chunk-set, never all-document (TDD)
tasks.description:

**Files:** Modify app/workers/pipeline.py (_resolve_mention_chunks ~1771; call site ~9323; legacy ~9416-9436; identity_map ~4870); Modify tests/unit/test_extracted_from_self_ref_resolution.py.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- _resolve_mention_chunks gains batch_chunk_ids; union over self_refs; batch-set fallback; all-document removed; ([],True)+WARN only if batch empty.
- Mention loop resolves self_refs LIST + derives batch_chunk_ids from chunk_indexes.
- Legacy content_metadata fan-out routed or gated, no all-document anywhere.
- identity_map↔#/texts/N gap closed; real #/texts/N resolves.
- 4 unit cases incl no-regression concrete uid.

tasks.subject: Task 6: Deploy + all-three-targets precise-lineage gate end-to-end (USER-ORDERED)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Rebuild+redeploy, harden verify_lineage_e2e.py to prove PRECISE lineage for entity + field + relationship with per-target recall baselines, and confirm on a fresh SA-2 graph_only run that lineage is precise (not all-document) on all three.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** Requested by the user this conversation. MUST NOT be closed by walking around it or substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every acceptanceCriteria item is re-validated independently with output captured.

**Files:** Modify scripts/verify_lineage_e2e.py.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Deploy: 0001-0006 applied green; up -d --force-recreate docling-graph; BOTH workers restarted; all 3 StartedAt advanced; container ir_normalizer.py shows cited_refs; pool idle.
- Entity precision (run-scoped): per-entity EXTRACTED_FROM ≤ batch width (≈1), NOT ~all; K-distribution; FAIL if any ≥50% doc chunks.
- Field precision: _field_evidence chunk_id resolved (0 hardcoded None).
- Relationship precision: edges carry source_chunk_ids within batch set.
- Per-target recall: entity vs audit merged; field vs property-evidence; rel vs post-validation accepted (rejected separate).
- Run-scoped + EXTRACTED_FROM-only trace + fail-closed.
- ALL CHECKS PASS.

**Verify:** python3 scripts/verify_lineage_e2e.py --run <run_id> --pre-extracted-from 0
